body:
What makes a real estate company good to work for?

Four things, in roughly this order: support (training, a manager who isn’t competing against you, real systems), economics (your take-home after every fee, not the headline split), culture (do people stay?), and brand (does the name help you win business?). A high split at a firm that gives you none of the first three is rarely the best place to work, only the best place to pay fees.

Why Adams, Cameron & Co. ranks for Flagler County agents

Adams, Cameron & Co. has served Flagler County with a dedicated team since 1963, with around 300 agents across Volusia and Flagler County and headquarters at 600 S. Atlantic Ave in Daytona Beach. Flagler County, anchored by Palm Coast, is one of Florida’s fastest-growing counties, ranked sixth in the state, and agents working that kind of growth need real support behind them. Agents cite the non-competing managers, the included marketing and technology, the training, and a genuine family culture. That’s why the firm appears on third-party “best places to work” lists. If support and a trusted local brand matter to you in a fast-growing market, it’s the established full-service choice.
